# TEACH Early Childhood® Florida

> > TEACH Early Childhood® Florida provides scholarships and wage supplements to support early childhood educators in Florida pursuing credentials, degrees, and professional development.

The site serves as the primary resource for Florida's early childhood workforce, offering information about the TEACH Scholarship Program and WAGE$ Florida supplement program. It connects educators with training opportunities, credential programs (including Florida Staff Credential, Director Credential, and Infant Toddler Certificate), and the ECE Training Directory.

## Key Topics

- TEACH Scholarship Program
- WAGE$ Florida
- Florida Staff Credential
- Director Credential
- Infant Toddler Certificate
- Early childhood education professional development
- Tuition assistance and reimbursement
- Credential renewal programs
- Childcare workforce development
- Paid release time for education
- Family Child Care Home (FCCH) providers
- ECE Training Directory
- Degree programs for early childhood educators
- Scholarship models and eligibility

## Scholarship Programs

- [Scholarship Models at a Glance](https://teach-fl.org/scholarship-models-at-a-glance): Overview of TEACH scholarship models for credentials and degree programs
- [Credential Renewals](https://teach-fl.org/scholarship-types/credential-renewals): Scholarship info for renewing early childhood education credentials

## Program Support

- [Ambassador Monthly Outreach & Activity Report](https://teach-fl.org/ambassador-monthly-outreach-activity-report): Monthly activity tracking form for TEACH program ambassadors

## Optional

- [TEACH & WAGE$ Florida Annual Report for 2006-2007](https://teach-fl.org/download/t-e-a-c-h-wage-florida-annual-report-for-2006-2007): Historical annual report for TEACH & WAGE$ programs from 2006-2007
- [TEACH & WAGE$ National Annual Report for 2013-2014](https://teach-fl.org/download/t-e-a-c-h-wage-national-annual-report-for-2013-2014): National annual report for TEACH & WAGE$ programs from 2013-2014
